fs.read.notes: covers bounded text/byte reads, stat, directory listing, and bounded path search

process.exec.notes: authorizes starting argv-vector processes; no implicit shell; cwd claim is not an OS sandbox; local workstation policy must explicitly enable process operations

process.inspect.notes: inspect/list/status/output is limited to opaque process handles owned by the same lane/fence

process.control.notes: termination is limited to opaque process handles owned by the same lane/fence

invariants: A lane capability set MUST be a subset of the authenticated session capability ceiling.
A child or parallel lane MUST NOT synthesize authority absent from its session ceiling.
Filesystem operations MUST be constrained by local workstation policy in addition to remote capability claims.
A cwd resource claim is collision/accounting metadata and MUST NOT be represented as sandboxing arbitrary process side effects.
process.exec, process.inspect, and process.control MUST remain unavailable unless local workstation process policy is explicitly enabled.
Managed process handles MUST remain bound to their owning lane and fencing token.
Network or transport membership MUST NOT itself grant any VeraPort capability.
